notes: Hermes v0.19.0 manual compaction via the REPL's /compress (alias /compact). Two priming turns are required first — _manual_compress refuses a history shorter than 4 messages (cli.py:10281). This spec asserts the CORRECT behavior per the scenario's acceptance criteria — one logical session, working for the whole compaction, ready afterwards — and is known_failing on two counts against the daemon as it stands: (1) nothing is written to sessions/messages while the summarizer call runs (the whole split is one transaction, hermes_state.py:4215), so no ready→working transition is emitted for the compaction; the only in-flight trace is a compression_locks lease the adapter does not read. (2) The default rotation path (compression.in_place=false, agent_init.py:1955) ends the parent with end_reason='compression' and mints a CHILD sessions row carrying parent_session_id, so the post-compaction turn lands on a different session id that irrlicht surfaces as a subagent-style child rather than stitching it onto the parent. Phases 6-10 are the failing ones; 1-5 pass today. Recording also needs the reset_session seam ported into drive-hermes-interactive.sh — see the assessment's Driver section.
